name: Oregon Inlet Campground

name: Smokemont Campground
winter_2026_27: open year round; Loops A and B bookable every night through 2027-03-31; Loops C, D and F closed

winter_limits: Reservation required; the office may be open only intermittently Nov-April (carry proof of occupancy). No showers or hookups. Generators allowed in A-C while D and F are closed. US 441 may close for snow (no refunds).
